name: Anthropic Messages
summary: Use the Anthropic-compatible Messages surface with x-api-key or Bearer auth.
statusNote: The Messages relay surface is exercised by Diffusion's transport test matrix.
prerequisites: A Diffusion Router API key from API keys.

setup.title: Point Anthropic tooling at Diffusion
setup.body: The Anthropic-compatible base URL has no /v1 suffix; clients append their own paths.

restart: Open a new terminal (or re-create your SDK client) so the environment is read.

verification.title: One curl exchange
verification.body: A 200 with a content block proves the surface end to end.

troubleshooting: 401/403: check the key and tenant binding in API keys.
Bearer also works on Messages; x-api-key matches the native Anthropic client.

removal.title: Unset the environment
removal.body: Remove the exports from your shell profile. Revoke the key in API keys if unused.

rollback: No files are modified; unsetting the variables returns the SDK to the Anthropic API.
